author: ETA PRIME
description:
GPD is known for their incredible handhelds, but today we are looking at something completely different: the brand-new GPD Box. This sleek mini PC is powered by Intel's highly anticipated Panther Lake architecture, specifically the Intel Core Ultra X7 358H, paired with the powerful Intel Arc B390 iGPU. In this video, we unbox the GPD Box, break down the insane connectivity (including the new 256 GB/s MCIO port for eGPUs), test out the dedicated GPD tuning software, and push this machine to its limits with benchmarks and 1440p gaming tests. Plus, we look at how the built-in 160W GaN power supply keeps your desk completely brick-free!
